text:
Mia Chen: dropping a screenshot + short brief: debating card-grid vs column list for the Usage & Billing dashboard. big ask: bulk invoice downloads (multiple projects/orgs) and keeping token cost visible. mock: https://figma.redwood/bulk-invoice-compact.png :file_folder:
Harper Nguyen: card-grid reads faster for product teams 30, but for finance a dense list with CSV actions per-row is easier. can we compromise? grid for overview + an inline list when you expand
Devon Patel: flag: bulk invoice export needs backend support for batching and job status. don't want synchronous download for 50 projects. should be async with email or workspace notification
Priya S: UX idea: add "Download invoices" primary CTA with a small date range pill and a format dropdown (CSV / ZIP of CSVs / XLSX). let users choose scope: org / selected projects
Olivia Park: accessibility note: the bulk job modal must announce job start and completion via aria-live; button needs aria-busy when running. Also color contrast on the compact totals chip is low on current mock
Mia Chen: good call. will add aria-live region copy and increase chip contrast. question on file naming: what should the batch zip contain vs single CSV filename format?
Devon Patel: suggest single invoice files per project named: <org_slug>_<project_slug>_<YYYY-MM>_invoice.csv, and zip named: <org_slug>_invoices_<YYYY-MM>_to_<YYYY-MM>.zip. backend should return a presigned URL once job completes
Priya S: UI: show a transient toast with a link, and also enqueue a notification in the console bell. include an ETA estimate and a download size estimate if possible
Harper Nguyen: layout debate: card-grid with inline microtable (3 rows) vs stacked list with full columns. for many projects the grid wraps and loses vertical alignment. list gives predictable scan lines for accountants
Olivia Park: copy tweak: change "Export" -> "Download invoices" and for batch action add helper text: "This may take a few minutes for large orgs." Also include keyboard-focusable rows with aria-checked for multi-select
DesignBot: accessibility scan: compact totals chip contrast 0.39 fail. bulk modal missing role="dialog" and focus trap. download links lack rel="noopener" on external presigned URLs
Devon Patel: security note: presigned URLs should be one-time use and expire quickly; server should revoke if job cancelled. also throttle request generation to avoid spamming S3
Mia Chen: will update mocks with list fallback, aria-live, higher contrast, and explicit download copy. also planning a small multi-select UX for choosing projects to include in batch
Eli (PM): prioritization: 1) async batch export with console notification + presigned URL 2) clear filenames and downloadable formats 3) accessible modal (focus trap & aria-live). layout choice (grid vs list) is 4) but we need a responsive pattern for both audiences
Priya S: micro-copy for aria-live: "Invoice export started for 12 projects; you will be notified when it is ready." and on completion: "Invoice export ready: click to download"
Harper Nguyen: small perf/UX nit: when switching org -> project scope, DO NOT reset the date range. make date-range sticky and show the pinned scope chip
Olivia Park: backend header example for Content-Disposition we can standardize: ```Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="redwood-inc_project-x_2025-03_invoice.csv";``` Ensure backend utf-8 and ascii-safe slugs
Devon Patel: add server-side manifest (JSON) inside the zip listing file names + checksums. helps accounting automation
Mia Chen: love the manifest idea. I'll add a line item in the mock for "download manifest" and include filename patterns. will update Figma and re-post when ready :white_check_mark:
